snippet.title: Space Rock Breaker - Official Console Gameplay Trailer | PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch
snippet.description:
Space Rock Breaker is officially coming to consoles on October 30th! 🚀 Blast asteroids, process ore in a Plinko machine, and conquer a massive skill tree on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch! 

Pre-order / Wishlist now on your favorite console store! 

If you love incremental games, idle clickers, and satisfying physics-based mechanics, Space Rock Breaker is your next addiction. Originally launched on Steam to "Overwhelmingly Positive" reviews, Games Harbor is proud to bring this indie gem to console players worldwide.

💥 ABOUT SPACE ROCK BREAKER 💥
Space Rock Breaker is a short, highly addictive incremental experience. Mine asteroids using powerful guns, missiles, and lasers to earn valuable ore. Drop your hard-earned materials into an upgradable Plinko machine to multiply your profits, and spend your credits on insane upgrades in a massive skill tree. Open lootboxes, discover rare ores, and see how deep into the cosmos you can go!

🎮 KEY FEATURES:
• Space Mining Action – Use lasers and missiles to obliterate asteroids.
• Plinko Machine Ore Processing – Drop ore for massive multipliers and chaotic fun.
• Massive Skill Tree – Spend credits to fully upgrade your spaceship and weapons.
• Lootboxes & Bonuses – Unlock secret rewards to boost your progression.
• Short & Satisfying – The perfect incremental casual game for console players.

👇 TIMESTAMPS 👇
0:00 - Asteroid Mining Action
0:15 - Plinko Ore Multiplier Mechanic
0:35 - Massive Skill Tree & Upgrades
0:50 - Console Release Date (Oct 30)
